summary: The automatic ChatGPT reopening (« continuité ChatGPT ») is removed: the ADB recovery watchdog, the Health Manager and the boot no longer reopen a saved ChatGPT conversation; the restore, capture and boot-continuity scripts and the chat.continuity health item are gone.
reason: Amine 29/10: ChatGPT kept coming to the front of the S24. S24 logs: chat-continuity-restore.sh reopened a conversation saved on 26/09 at every ADB reconnection and every ~15 s after a reboot while the phone was locked (the restore could not see ChatGPT in front and retried): 668 openings on 29/10, more than 500 a day on 21-23/10 and 27/10. Stopped live the same day by renaming the checkpoint; Amine decided to remove the reopening (« oui retire la réouverture ChatGPT »).

tests.name: installer/termux-lite/test-incident-runtime-hardening.sh
tests.evidence: Now asserts that neither the ADB watchdog, the Health Manager nor tier0-bootstrap mention chat-continuity or boot-continuity, and that chat-continuity-restore.sh no longer exists.

tests.name: installer/termux-lite/test-health-*.py, test-whatsapp-channel-health.py
tests.evidence: Health verdict and Health Manager tests green without the chat.continuity item.

capabilities.reason: No registered capability; an automatic side effect and its health indicator are removed.

architecture.reason: Callers removed from existing owners; no new component.

evidence: ADB recovery, Health Manager and boot paths only.

limitations: Full canonical CI on the final GitHub head remains required.
The renamed checkpoint ~/.openclaw/continuity/chatgpt-current.json.disabled-20261029 stays on the S24 as a backup.
rollback: Revert this commit and redeploy the core.
